beats.text: Well... I told Amy that the game is today
It's about time, so what's the-
...and we had an argument
Oh!
Oh!
She's mad at you, isn't she?
She'd still be mad at me if I told her earlier
You idiot! If you told her earlier then you guys would've had the chance to sort this out,
but now you can't. You have a game tonight!
Who says I wanna sort this out? She kicked me out of her house at night! I'm mad at her too!
What'd you expect her to do? Let you both kill each other in her house?
I'm gonna agree with Tails on this one
Yeah but I was gonna say we could plan the date another day till she interrupted me and started the argument!
Tikal sometimes interrupts me, it's annoying
Cosmo ALWAYS interrupted me, I don't even like her anymore
That's because you like Cream *chuckles*
Yeah. I do
I'm talking about the likey like way
I love her
*chuckles* Didn't see that coming
LOOK AT KNUCKLE'S FACE! *LAUGHING*
HAHAHAHA!!
Sonic, we need to talk *puts his arm around him*
Look, you can't let this argument get in the way of your game!
Don't you remember who you're against?
Yeah, Scourge
and are you gonna let him win?
OF COURSE NOT!
So how about you get that argument out the way and getcha head in the game
You're right...
SO WHO'S THIS ABOUT?
US!
AND WHO'S GONNA WIN?!
US!
AND WHO ARE WE?!
SEGA!

beats.title: the two heroes charge toward the big game
the boys get their heads in the game
